verdict.rationale: Atlas's own docs say it issues founders equity with customizable vesting and files 83(b) elections for all C-corp founders, using templates built with Cooley LLP, so the core post-incorporation paperwork is covered. However, IP assignment is never explicitly documented, and no independent hands-on report confirms the founder stock or 83(b) flow. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of IP/technology assignment agreements, detail on founder stock purchase agreements, independent corroboration of the 83(b) filing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can complete post-incorporation setup — founder stock purchases, IP assignment, and 83(b) elections — with correct standard paperwork
